messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT alert — embeddings-hot route high latency & error spike, paging alice

alice: on it, looking at traces + QPS patterns

alice: dashboard -> https://dash.redwood/graphs/embeddings-hot recent 10m spike from tenant 'QoreMetrics'

carla: support got a customer DM, QoreMetrics seeing 5xxs and timeouts in prod

alice: initial plan: 1) carve per-route QPS to protect chat 2) disable rerank for heavy tenants 3) scale embeddings workers if needed

ben: +1 to carve. Recommend embeddings qps -> 12 for embeddings-hot and rerank -> 1 (best-effort) so chat SLOs hold

alice: applying temporary per-endpoint quota now: embeddings-hot -> 12qps, burst 24; rerank-route -> 1qps

alice: ```
/runadmin route update --name embeddings-hot --qps 12 --burst 24 --note "live mitigation 4372105678 alice"
```

deploy-bot: command accepted — embeddings-hot qps changed from 48 -> 12 (burst 24) by alice

carla: opening incident ticket #INC-1234, noting impacted tenants: QoreMetrics (prod), INTEGRATE-42 (staging)

dave: will this touch PLG free users?

alice: free PLG traffic may see 429s for embeddings heavy calls; we're prioritizing paid chat traffic and keeping chat routes at normal limits

ben: starting scale for embeddings-worker-pool (may take ~6m). If spike persists we'll horizontally add one more worker group

deploy-bot: scale job queued: embeddings-worker-pool x2 (triggered by ben)

alice: handoff — ben, I'm handing oncall to you for the next 30m while I handle customer comms. monitor latency and errors, relax qps slowly if stable

ben: ack, taking over. I'll watch infra logs and incrementally relax embeddings qps +4qps every 3m if error rate <1%

incident-bot: Incident severity set -> sev2. Notifying rotation schedule and SRE oncall

carla: customer update drafted and sent: "We applied temporary rate limits for embeddings to protect latency-sensitive routes. Expect service restoration within ~20 minutes. We'll follow up with postmortem." :email:

dave: who owns the postmortem?

ben: I'll own the immediate postmortem and tag infra/product for root cause analysis

alice: summary note: temporary per-endpoint carve applied to embeddings-hot, rerank best-effort, scaling in progress, handoff to ben. Will update ticket with metrics snapshot in 30m :thumbsup:

ben: will post follow-up in this thread when normalized or if we need further mitigation

alice: thanks everyone, closing this thread for handoff
